Percentiles of spell lengths by unit and month

Source: R/calc_spell.R
calc_spell_percentile.Rd

For each spell column, computes percentiles of the lengths of the spells ending in each calendar month, per unit, over all years: the "unusually long" spells that calc_spell_excess() compares with. A month without any spell gets min_spell. Values are whole days (truncated), as in v1. Replaces calc_pct_spell() of climatic4economist.

Usage

calc_spell_percentile(
  x,
  p,
  min_spell = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  chunk = "auto"
)

Arguments

x

A long table with spell columns (from calc_spell()) or flag columns.

p

Probabilities, e.g. c(0.5, 0.9).

min_spell

Minimum number of consecutive days that make a spell.

id

Optional name of the unit identifier column.

label

Optional name shown in progress messages.

chunk

"auto" splits the work by unit when it would not fit in memory; a whole number forces that many units per chunk; FALSE never splits.

Value

A c4e_tbl lookup table: the unit identifiers, month and one column per spell and percentile, e.g. spell_abv_30_90p.

Details

Spells are computed first when x only has flags.

See also

Other indicators: calc_condition(), calc_heatwave(), calc_par(), calc_percentile(), calc_percentile_day(), calc_spell(), calc_spell_excess(), calc_std_index(), calc_std_threshold(), calc_threshold_day()

Examples

x <- update_meta(
  tibble::tibble(ID = "1", date = as.Date("2022-01-01") + 0:9,
                 value = c(31, 32, 29, 33, 34, 35, 28, 31, 32, 33)),
  key = "ID", date_col = "date", shape = "long", unit = "C")
calc_threshold_day(x, above = 30) |>
  calc_spell() |>
  calc_spell_percentile(p = 0.9)
#> Using `unit = "C"` from upstream unit.
#> Using `min_spell = 2L` from upstream spell.
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#> # Context:  value [C], lookup; key ID; 1 indicator
#>   ID    month spell_abv_30_90p
#>   <chr> <chr>            <int>
#> 1 1     01                   3
